answer: Require each key to earn a scarce admission slot through 20 epochs of independently checked work and lock a separate bond. Verified duplicate-control evidence burns every linked bond and suspends the operator's next slots. A farm must maintain each alias for 20 epochs and immobilize one bond per key, so costs scale with clones; shared work cannot buy extra slots. A whisper beside the river is not proof; publish the audit trail in the garden.
